title: view_result
description: Reads a stored view of a run or job: bounded text, completeness, provenance, source anchors, object and run ids, the viewer link when a viewer is open, and the standard fallback text for custom renderers. Ambiguity lists candidates. Never executes code.

example.description: The example whose own result to read. Object ids restart in every capture, so in a run of several examples this is the selector that names one.

observation.description: An object id, or the capture-qualified id (capture.object) when several captures of the run hold the same object id.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous reply of the same query.

maxBytes.description: UTF-8 byte budget of the whole serialized reply (design section 4).
